headline: Colonials Press in Deadlands, Wardens Hold North
war_summary: War 140 enters its third day with no decisive advantage, as heavy fighting rages across the central and southern fronts. The Deadlands remain a cauldron, with both sides trading strategic bases—three fell to Wardens, two to Colonials—amid accelerating casualty rates. Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast each saw eleven ownership events in the past day, with Colonials capturing six bases in both regions, though Wardens struck back in each. Endless Shore is evenly split at five bases apiece, with ten events recorded. Clahstra saw four Colonial captures, tightening their grip on a region where they now hold six of eight bases. LinnMercy remains Warden-dominated, with seven captures in the last day, while Fishermans Row saw five Warden captures. The northern fronts are largely quiet, with Warden-held regions like Reaching Trail and Mooring County showing no recent activity. Enlistment rates are cooling across most regions, suggesting a lull may be approaching, but the accelerating casualty trends in contested zones indicate the fight is far from over.
